title: Cerebus Jaka's Story 16 #129 Dec - Aarevark-Vanaheim Comic Book
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book titled "Cerebus Jaka's Story 16 #129 Dec" published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. It features the character Cerebus, a mysterious and powerful being who plays a significant role in the comic book. The comic book is a single issue format and is part of the Modern Age (1992-Now) era of US Comics tradition.

The comic book is boarded and in excellent condition, making it a great addition to any comic book collection. It belongs to the Comics genre and is a perfect read for fans of the Cerebus series. Get your hands on this single unit comic book and enjoy the fascinating story of Cerebus and his adventures.
